description: This file defines the EKSException class, which represents errors related to the Amazon Elastic Container Service for Kubernetes (EKS) within the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends the general AwsException class and is part of the AWS SDK's EKS exception namespace.

classes.name: EKSException
classes.description: A specific exception class for errors encountered when interacting with Amazon EKS, extending the general AWS exception handling framework.

methods.name: EKSException
methods.description: Constructor method, inherited from AwsException; used for instantiating EKSException objects.
